blocks.html: Leading real estate and office space provider Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) formalized its lease agreement with Linde Gas Asia Pte. Ltd. – ROHQ, a fast growing shared services organization of the The Linde Group – a world-leading gases and engineering company operating in more than 100 countries worldwide. “Finding the right developer and business partner for the office space can be a daunting experience for a business organization like us. And when it comes to critical investment as the office space, we cannot afford to make any mistake,” says Heiko Kaefer, Head of Linde Global Services – Manila. Linde Gas Asia Pte. Ltd. – ROHQ operates in RLC’s PEZA- registered office building in Taguig City- Cyber Sigma. The 20-storey office building, located at Lawton Avenue, McKinley West, Fort Bonifacio, Taguig City, comprises 14 large-plate office floors, 5 podium parking floors with 1 lower ground parking, and 2 levels of retail, services and dining options. The building is also notable for its green features which include rainwater harvesting system, sewage treatment plant, LED Lighting, water-efficient fixtures, provision of landscape areas and use of reflective glass. It is ideally located close to the Bonifacio Global City, Makati Central Business District, and the International Airport. Public transportation is available along Lawton Avenue. There are public transport options going to EDSA, Magallanes MRT station, Guadalupe MRT station, and the Market Market transport terminal that will connect employees to different parts of Mega-Manila. The building is equipped with N+1 back-up power provision, Mitsubishi elevators and air-conditioning and has generous open space at the ground floor. According to Mr. Kaefer, Cyber Sigma is aligned with their requirements on safety provisions. LGS-Manila, being part of a global industrial gas company, “safety” is a primary and critical requirement. The design of fire exits, reliable equipment (e.g. elevators) and having obtained strict certifications/standards is a checklist that Cyber Sigma has achieved. The building offers a spacious floor plate, giving them flexibility to design according to the needs of a shared services format. Another advantage would be its proximity to the BGC area making it a combination of a metropolitan ambiance and green environment- a unique combination to look forward to. “The property presented by Robinsons Land stood out from all other options we were looking at. They understand our business requirements, their offering fits our expectations and they were reasonably fair with our demands. We are confident that RLC is a reliable business partner and has a good reputation on the quality of work of their development projects. But on top of that, we are very satisfied with the excellent customer experience that they provide even after closing the deal with us,” Mr. Kaefer noted. To date, there are 13 RLC office developments located in the country’s key cities and central business districts. Upcoming office pipelines for 2017 and 2018 include Cybergate Naga in Naga City, Cybergate Delta in Davao City, Cyberscape Gamma in Ortigas CBD, Exxa and Zeta Towers in Quezon Cirty.
